title: A brief review on the palladium-catalyzed C–H activation reactions of 2-phenylpyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11065-11084
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01203A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jesly Joy, T. D. Demina, Amruta Kush Durgi, Ajesh Vijayan
This review highlights two decades of progress in palladium-catalyzed ortho-C–H functionalisation of 2-phenyl pyridine, showcasing its regioselectivity, broad scope, and relevance in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and material science.
